 Donovan Mitchell fills stat sheet in Saturday's win over Nets 
 by Chris Schommer | Cavaliers Correspondent | Sun, Oct 25th 2026, 2:30pm EDT 
 Donovan Mitchell filled the stat sheet for the Cavaliers Saturday night, dishing out four assists, recording one steal, grabbing five rebounds, blocking one shot, and scoring 22 points (7-15 FG, 2-6 3PT, 6-6 FT) in a 125-121 win over the Nets. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Mitchell has been impactful on both ends of the floor to begin the season, dishing out three or more assists, grabbing five or more rebounds, and scoring 22 or more points in each of the first two contests. The guard offers head coach Kenny Atkinson one of the more explosive options as part of a versatile Cleveland starting five, averaging 27.0 points, 1.5 steals, 3.5 assists, and 7.5 rebounds per game while carrying a usage rate of 28.2% so far this season.
